heading: INT. FROZEN TUNA AUCTION HALL - BEFORE DAWN

units.text: INT. FROZEN TUNA AUCTION HALL - BEFORE DAWN
Concrete floor, steel hooks, rows of frozen tuna laid out like torpedoes under hard white lights.
Breath hangs in the air.
HANA ARAKAWA, 40s, crew leader, wears a fish-market apron over a black thermal.
BIG LOU DELACROIX, 50s, heavyset, carries a hand truck.
PRIYA NAIR, late 20s, tablet strapped to her forearm, checks tags.
TEDDY BRANCA, 30s, jittery, wears a forklift vest.
INSPECTOR WU, 60s, a night guard with a thermos, stands by the scale.
Number forty-one. The one with the red tag.
units.name: HANA

units.text: Forty-one is clean. The case is in the belly. Eleven kilos, give or take.
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: Eleven kilos of what, again? Nobody told me it was in a fish.
units.name: BIG LOU

units.text: Bearer bonds. Sealed in plastic. Don't ask who put them there.
units.name: HANA

units.text: I'm asking. I'm asking right now.
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: Wu is on the scale. When he turns, Lou, you move the truck.
units.name: HANA

units.text: You people are early again.
units.name: INSPECTOR WU

units.text: Auction prep, Inspector. Same as every Tuesday.
units.name: HANA

units.text: Wu sips from the thermos, then steps away from the scale.
Lou rolls the hand truck forward.
Teddy drops a clipboard.
It clatters.
Everyone freezes.
Unit nine, come in. Unit nine.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Nine here. Go ahead.
units.name: INSPECTOR WU

units.text: Customs wants forty-one held for inspection. Do not release it.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Wu looks at the red tag.
Looks at Hana.
Hana smiles with her mouth only.
Dual-dialogue time, boys.
units.name: HANA

units.text: Customs? Nobody said customs.
units.name: BIG LOU

units.text: I flagged it clean an hour ago, I swear.
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: Priya, the tag. Swap it for thirty-eight.
units.name: HANA

units.text: Thirty-eight is a dud. It's actual fish.
units.name: PRIYA

units.text: Then it'll pass. Teddy, distract him.
units.name: HANA

units.text: With what?
units.name: TEDDY

units.text: Cry. You're good at it.
units.name: HANA

units.text: Teddy sobs loudly, dramatically.
Wu turns.
Priya swaps the tags.
Lou hauls forty-one onto the truck and wheels it toward the loading door.
Unit nine, confirm hold on forty-one.
units.name: DISPATCH

units.text: Forty-one is on hold. Confirmed.
units.name: INSPECTOR WU

units.text: The loading door rolls up.
Gray dawn floods in.
Lou pushes through.
The others scatter.
